description: 3-stage mass assignment via SQLAlchemy JSON column persistence quirk: (1) add preferences JSON column to User model + GET endpoint, (2) add PUT /api/user/preferences that deserialises request body and merges into column — but SQLAlchemy skips the update because it tracks identity not content for JSON, (3) fix persistence by adding flag_modified('preferences') before commit — now arbitrary user-controlled JSON persists including role escalation fields.
